name: Onee-chan Cube
original_name: お姉ちゃんの3乗（きゅーぶ）
source:
College student Arisaka Miku lives alone with his cousin two years his senior, Shunzaki Nanatsu. The pair spend their school days as any would until one day, a mysterious distortion in the space-time continuum splits Nanami into three girls. Their names, looks, and personalities are all different but they are certainly still "Miku's older sister". Then a fairy from another world comes to investigate the distortion...

So begins this strange tale of cohabitation with three times the [i]onee-sans[/i] and three times the pampering!

[Based on synopsis from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110224160534/http://www.marron.nu:80/web/product/sis_cube/index.html]official website[/url] and back of game box]
translation:
大学生有坂未空与年长两岁的表姐春崎七夏共同生活。两人原本过着寻常的校园日子，直到某天，神秘的时空扭曲把七夏分裂成三名少女。她们的姓名、外貌与性格各不相同，却无疑都还是“未空的姐姐”。随后，一名来自异世界的妖精也前来调查这场扭曲……

三倍的[i]姐姐[/i]，三倍的宠爱，一段奇妙的同居故事就此开始！

[根据 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110224160534/http://www.marron.nu:80/web/product/sis_cube/index.html]官方网站[/url]与游戏盒背面简介整理]
